data.explanation: This is your landlord's yearly operating cost statement, delivered by hand on 19 November 2026. It shows your share of building costs (based on your 74 m² of the 612 m² total) and heating costs (based on consumption), compared against what you already paid in advance. You owe an additional €186.60, to be transferred to the landlord's account by 15 December 2026. Check the figures against your own records; you can arrange to inspect the underlying receipts (Belege) at their office. If something seems wrong, contact the landlord before the due date — there is no formal appeal procedure since this is not an authority decision, just a private accounting.
